        var i, tabcontent, tabitems;
    
        // Hide all tab contents and remove 'active' class
        tabcontent = document.getElementsByClassName("tabcontent");
        for (i = 0; i < tabcontent.length; i++) {
            tabcontent[i].classList.remove("active");
            // Delay hiding to allow transition out (optional)
            setTimeout((el => () => el.style.display = "none")(tabcontent[i]), 500);
        }
    
        // Remove active class from all tab <li>
        tabitems = document.querySelectorAll(".nav-tabs li");
        for (i = 0; i < tabitems.length; i++) {
            tabitems[i].classList.remove("active");
        }
    
        // Show the selected tab content and trigger animation
        var selectedTab = document.getElementById(cityName);
        selectedTab.style.display = "block";
        setTimeout(() => {
            selectedTab.classList.add("active");
        }, 10); // Delay ensures transition applies

        evt.currentTarget.parentElement.classList.add("active");
    }

require([
    "jquery"
], function($){
    $(document).ready(function() {

        $(document).on("click", ".header_login", function() {
            $('.login_content_header').toggleClass("loginpopupactive");
            $('body').addClass("loginpopup_active");
        });

        $(document).on("click", ".header_logout", function() {
            $('.login_content_logout').toggleClass("loginpopupactive");
            $('body').addClass("loginpopup_active");
        });

        $(document).on("click", ".mobile-login-close", function(){
            $('.login_content_header').removeClass("loginpopupactive");
            $('.login_content_logout').removeClass("loginpopupactive");
            $('body').removeClass("loginpopup_active");
        });

        var isNavigating = false;

        $(document).on("touchstart click", ".mh-sign-in-btn, .create-acct-btn", function(e){
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();

            if (isNavigating) {
                return;
            }

            var href = $(this).attr('href');

            if (href && href !== 'javascript:void(0)' && href !== '#') {
                isNavigating = true;
                e.preventDefault();
                setTimeout(function () {
                    window.location.href = href;
                }, 0);
            }
        });

    });
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const PAUSE_ICON = `<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M5.999 16H4.809V0H6V16ZM11.2 16H10V0H11.2V16Z"/></svg>`;
  const PLAY_ICON  = `<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M8 0C10.12 0 12.16.843 13.66 2.343 15.16 3.843 16 5.878 16 8c0 1.582-.47 3.129-1.35 4.444-.879 1.316-2.13 2.341-3.59 2.947-1.462.606-3.07.765-4.622.456-1.55-.309-2.975-1.071-4.094-2.19C1.225 12.538.463 11.112.154 9.56-.155 8.01.003 6.4.609 4.938c.605-1.461 1.63-2.71 2.946-3.59C4.87.469 6.417 0 8 0Zm2.652 1.597A6.93 6.93 0 0 0 8 1.07a6.93 6.93 0 0 0-4.9 2.03A6.93 6.93 0 0 0 1.07 8c0 1.37.406 2.71 1.165 3.85.759 1.14 1.84 2.028 3.11 2.548 1.27.52 2.664.657 4.008.39a6.93 6.93 0 0 0 3.578-1.948A6.93 6.93 0 0 0 14.93 8c0-1.37-.406-2.71-1.165-3.85-.76-1.14-1.84-2.028-3.11-2.553ZM5.29 13.31V2.69L13.63 8 5.29 13.31Z"/></svg>`;
  const REPLAY_ICON= `<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M15 0v7.35H7.62V6.28h5.54C12.67 5.36 11.94 4.59 11.06 4.04c-.89-.55-1.9-.85-2.95-.87-1.04-.025-2.07.228-2.98.731-.91.504-1.67 1.24-2.21 2.134-.53.895-.816 1.915-.826 2.957-.01 1.04.257 2.066.774 2.97.516.905 1.263 1.656 2.165 2.177.9.52 1.927.793 2.966.788V16c-1.213.005-2.406-.308-3.461-.908C1.48 14.492.6 13.626.984 12.581.371 11.536.038 10.348.024 9.135.009 7.921.312 6.725.903 5.665c.591-1.059 1.45-1.945 2.49-2.57 1.04-.625 2.226-.968 3.44-.993 1.21-.025 2.41.268 3.474.85 1.064.582 1.959 1.433 2.592 2.467V0H15Z"/></svg>`;

  function init () {
    const container = document.querySelector('.vto-pdp');
    if (!container) return;

    const video = container.querySelector('.vto-hero-media__video');
    const btn   = container.querySelector('.vto-hero-media__btn');
    if (!video || !btn) return;

    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

    const pauseLabel  = btn.dataset.vtoPause  || 'Pause video';
    const playLabel   = btn.dataset.vtoPlay   || 'Play video';
    const replayLabel = btn.dataset.vtoReplay || 'Replay video';

    let endedFired = false;

    function showPoster () { container.classList.remove('is-video-ready'); }
    function hidePoster () { container.classList.add('is-video-ready');    }

    function setPause () { btn.innerHTML = PAUSE_ICON;  btn.setAttribute('aria-label', pauseLabel);  }
    function setPlay  () { btn.innerHTML = PLAY_ICON;   btn.setAttribute('aria-label', playLabel);   }
    function setReplay() { btn.innerHTML = REPLAY_ICON; btn.setAttribute('aria-label', replayLabel); }

    function sync () {
      if (video.ended || endedFired) { setReplay(); }
      else if (video.paused)         { setPlay();   }
      else                           { setPause();  }
    }

    video.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => { hidePoster(); sync(); });
    video.addEventListener('play',    sync);
    video.addEventListener('playing', sync);
    video.addEventListener('pause',   () => { if (!video.ended) sync(); });
    video.addEventListener('ended',   () => { endedFired = true; sync(); });
    video.addEventListener('error',   () => { showPoster(); sync(); });

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (video.ended || endedFired) {
        endedFired = false;
        video.currentTime = 0;
        video.play().catch(() => {});
      } else if (video.paused) {
        video.play().catch(() => {});
      } else {
        video.pause();
      }
    });

    // mark ready on load
    if (video.readyState >= 2) hidePoster();
    setPause();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
require([
    'jquery',
    'Magento_Ui/js/modal/modal',
    'mage/validation'
], function ($, modal) {

    var form = $('#pre-book-form');
    var popup = $('#pre-book-popup');

    var options = {
        type: 'popup',
        responsive: true,
        innerScroll: true,
        modalClass: 'pre-book-modal',
        clickableOverlay: true,
        title: '',
        buttons: [],

        opened: function () {
            $('.modals-overlay').show().addClass('_show');
            $('body').addClass('_has-modal');
        },

        closed: function () {
            resetForm();

            $('.modals-overlay')
                .removeClass('_show')
                .hide();

            $('body').removeClass('_has-modal');
        }
    };

    modal(options, popup);

    // Open Popup
    $('.pre-book-btn').on('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        resetForm();

        popup.modal('openModal');

        // Force overlay for first load
        setTimeout(function () {
            $('.modals-overlay').show().addClass('_show');
            $('body').addClass('_has-modal');
        }, 10);
    });

    // Reset Form
    function resetForm() {

        if (form.length) {
            form[0].reset();
        }

        form.find('label.mage-error').remove();
        form.find('div.mage-error').remove();

        form.find('.mage-error').removeClass('mage-error');
        form.find('._error').removeClass('_error');
        form.find('.error').removeClass('error');

        form.find('input, textarea, select').each(function () {
            $(this)
                .removeClass('mage-error')
                .removeAttr('aria-invalid')
                .removeAttr('aria-describedby');
        });

        if (form.data('validator')) {
            form.validate().resetForm();
        }

        $('#pre-book-success').hide();
        form.show();
    }

    // AJAX Submit
    form.on('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!form.validation('isValid')) {
            return false;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "https://www.dellstore.com/salescallback/ajax/save/",
            type: "POST",
            data: form.serialize(),
            dataType: "json",
            showLoader: true,

<script>
require(["jquery"], function($) {
    $(document).ready(function() {

        var sections = $('.topsection'); // sab nav items
        var sectionIds = sections.map(function() {
            return $(this).find('a').attr('href'); // #overview, #configurations ...
        }).get();

        var $sidebar = $('.right_sec_inner');
        var bottomBuffer = 550;

        // --- Scroll ke basis pe active class set karna ---
        function setActiveOnScroll() {
            var scrollPos = $(window).scrollTop();
            var foundActive = false;

            for (var i = sectionIds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                var section = $(sectionIds[i]);
                if (section.length && scrollPos >= section.offset().top - 100) {
                    sections.removeClass('active');
                    $('.topsection').eq(i).addClass('active');
                    foundActive = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!foundActive) {
                sections.removeClass('active');
                $('.overviewtopsection').addClass('active');
            }
        }

        // --- Sidebar fixed logic (scroll-based add, Overview ke niche remove) ---
                    function handleSidebar() {
                var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
                var windowHeight = $(window).height();
                var documentHeight = $(document).height();
                var maxScroll = documentHeight - windowHeight - bottomBuffer;

                // Default: add fixed if scroll > 100
                if (scrollTop > 100) {
                    $sidebar.addClass('fixed');
                } else {
                    $sidebar.removeClass('fixed').css('transform', '');
                }

                // Remove fixed if active section is NOT Overview
                if (!$('.overviewtopsection').hasClass('active')) {
                    $sidebar.removeClass('fixed').css('transform', '');
                }

                // Overscroll translate
                if ($sidebar.hasClass('fixed')) {
                    if (scrollTop >= maxScroll) {
                        var overscroll = scrollTop - maxScroll;
                        $sidebar.css('transform', 'translateY(-' + overscroll + 'px)');
                    } else {
                        $sidebar.css('transform', 'translateY(0)');
                    }
                }
            }
                // --- Scroll event ---
        $(window).on('scroll', function() {
            // Mobile sticky
            var mobileelement = $('.position-relative');
            if ($(window).scrollTop() > 200) {
                mobileelement.addClass('mobilesticky');
            } else {
                mobileelement.removeClass('mobilesticky');
            }

            setActiveOnScroll();
            handleSidebar();
        });

        $(window).on('resize', handleSidebar);

        // Click events (active nav)
        $('.topsection').on('click', function() {
            sections.removeClass('active');
            $(this).addClass('active');
        });

        $('.overviewtopsection').on('click', function() {
            $('html, body').animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 'slow');
        });

        // Initial call on page load
        setActiveOnScroll();
        handleSidebar();
    });
});
</script>

        function setCookie(cname,cvalue,exdays) {
            var d = new Date();
            d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays*24*60*60*1000));
            var expires = "expires=" + d.toGMTString();
            document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
        }
        
        function getCookie(cname) {
            var name = cname + "=";
            var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
            for(var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                var c = ca[i];
                while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                    c = c.substring(1);
                }
                if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                    return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
                }
            }
            return "";
        }

    <script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            const popup = document.getElementById("exchangePopup");
            const originalPopupHTML = popup.innerHTML;

            function resetPopupContent() {
                popup.innerHTML = originalPopupHTML;
                attachFormValidation(); // Attach validation again after reset
            }

            function closePopup() {
                popup.style.display = "none";
                resetPopupContent();
            }

            document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                if (
                    e.target.classList.contains("close-popup") || 
                    e.target.classList.contains("cancel-btn")
                ) {
                    closePopup();
                }
                bindDeviceConditionEvents();
            });

            function attachFormValidation() {
                const form = document.getElementById("myForm");
                if (!form) return;

                form.addEventListener("submit", function(event) {
                    let isValid = true;
                    let firstInvalidInput = null;

                    function showError(inputId, errorId) {
                        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
                        const error = document.getElementById(errorId);
                        const inputField = input.closest('.input-field');

                        if (input.value.trim() === "") {
                            error.style.display = "block";
                            input.classList.add("error-border");
                            inputField.classList.add("input-focus");
                            isValid = false;
                            if (!firstInvalidInput) {
                                firstInvalidInput = input;
                            }
                        } else {
                            error.style.display = "none";
                            input.classList.remove("error-border");
                            inputField.classList.remove("input-focus");
                        }
                    }

                    showError("name", "nameError");
                    showError("address", "addressError");
                    showError("town", "townError");
                    showError("state", "stateError");

                    // Email validation
                    const email = document.getElementById("email");
                    const emailError = document.getElementById("emailError");
                    const emailField = email.closest('.input-field');
                    if (email.value.trim() === "") {
                        emailError.innerText = "Please type";
                        emailError.style.display = "block";
                        email.classList.add("error-border");
                        emailField.classList.add("input-focus");
                        isValid = false;
                        if (!firstInvalidInput) {
                            firstInvalidInput = email;
                        }
                    } else if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email.value)) {
                        emailError.innerText = "Enter a valid email.";
                        emailError.style.display = "block";
                        email.classList.add("error-border");
                        emailField.classList.add("input-focus");
                        isValid = false;
                        if (!firstInvalidInput) {
                            firstInvalidInput = email;
                        }
                    } else {
                        emailError.style.display = "none";
                        email.classList.remove("error-border");
                        emailField.classList.remove("input-focus");
                    }

                    // Phone validation
                    const phone = document.getElementById("phone");
                    const phoneError = document.getElementById("phoneError");
                    const phoneField = phone.closest('.input-field');

                    if (phone.value.trim() === "" || !/^\d+$/.test(phone.value)) {
                        phoneError.style.display = "block";
                        phone.classList.add("error-border");
                        phoneField.classList.add("input-focus");
                        isValid = false;
                        if (!firstInvalidInput) {
                            firstInvalidInput = phone;
                        }
                    } else {
                        phoneError.style.display = "none";
                        phone.classList.remove("error-border");
                        phoneField.classList.remove("input-focus");
                    }

                    // Optional fields - mark classes
                    const buildingField = document.getElementById("Building")?.closest('.input-field');
                    const pincodeField = document.getElementById("pincode")?.closest('.input-field');
                    buildingField?.classList.add("building_norequire");
                    pincodeField?.classList.add("code_norequire");

                    if (!isValid) {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        if (firstInvalidInput) {
                            firstInvalidInput.focus();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            // Attach validation on initial load
            attachFormValidation();
        });
    </script>

{
    var ajoinput = document.querySelector("#loginotpmob"),
        loginerrorMsg = document.querySelector("#login-mob-error-msg");
    // here, the index maps to the error code returned from getValidationError - see readme
    var loginerrorMap = [$t("Invalid number"), $t("Invalid country code"), $t("Too short"), $t("Too long"), $t("Invalid number")];

    // initialise plugin
    var ajoiti = window.intlTelInput(ajoinput, {
        utilsScript: "https://dellstatic.luroconnect.com/static/version1784691020/frontend/Dell/dellindia/en_US/Magecomp_Mobilelogin/js/utils.js"
    });

    jQuery.get('https://ipinfo.io', function() {}, "jsonp").always(function(resp) {
        countryCode = (resp && resp.country) ? resp.country : "";
        ajoiti.setCountry(countryCode);
    });

    var reset = function() {
        ajoinput.classList.remove("error");
        loginerrorMsg.innerHTML = "";
    };

    // on blur: validate
    ajoinput.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        reset();
        if (ajoinput.value.trim()) {
            if (ajoiti.isValidNumber()) {
				loginerrorMsg.innerHTML = "";
            } else {
                var errorCode = ajoiti.getValidationError();
                loginerrorMsg.innerHTML = loginerrorMap[errorCode];
            }
        }
    });
});

<script>
require(['jquery','mage/translate','jquery/ui','mage/mage','mage/validation'], function($,$t)
{
    var afoinput = document.querySelector("#forgotmob"),
        forgoterrorMsg = document.querySelector("#forgot-mob-error-msg");
    // here, the index maps to the error code returned from getValidationError - see readme
    var forgoterrorMap = [$t("Invalid number"), $t("Invalid country code"), $t("Too short"), $t("Too long"), $t("Invalid number")];

    // initialise plugin
    var afoiti = window.intlTelInput(afoinput, {
        utilsScript: "https://dellstatic.luroconnect.com/static/version1784691020/frontend/Dell/dellindia/en_US/Magecomp_Mobilelogin/js/utils.js"
    });

    jQuery.get('https://ipinfo.io', function() {}, "jsonp").always(function(resp) {
        countryCode = (resp && resp.country) ? resp.country : "";
        afoiti.setCountry(countryCode);
    });

    var reset = function() {
        afoinput.classList.remove("error");
        forgoterrorMsg.innerHTML = "";
    };

    // on blur: validate
    afoinput.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        reset();
        if (afoinput.value.trim()) {
            if (afoiti.isValidNumber()) {
				forgoterrorMsg.innerHTML = "";
            } else {
                var errorCode = afoiti.getValidationError();
                forgoterrorMsg.innerHTML = forgoterrorMap[errorCode];
            }
        }
    });
});
</script>
